messages.subject: Offer for paid Shiny App development project - please get in touch!
parts:
Hi!

I love the Shiny App framework and am currently evaluating it for my own work. In order to do that I would like to build 2 small Shiny Apps to see whether they fit my needs. As I don't have enough time to do it myself, I am looking for a knowledgeable Shiny App developer who can build this for me.

Please find some more details below. I very much look forward to your replies!

And to the Shiny App team: Awesome stuff and keep up the great work! :)

Thanks, Ignacio

----------------------------

General description (I'm happy to share more details on request)

I would like to build 2 Shiny Apps that are able to

1) send a request to a REST web service
2) receive the resulting data from that request in the JSON format
3) create visualizations based on these data

Shiny app 1: Bar chart with 5 filter controls
Shiny app 2: 2 tables in tabs with 3 controls

Payment: USD 100-200 (ideally via Elance.com; alternatively via some other freelancer site)

Start date: Immediately
